unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：in（向内）+ crease（折痕） -> 折痕越加越多，即“增多；增加”。其反义词为 decrease（减少）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She has some knowledge of fashion.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：know（知道）演变而来的名词，-ledge为名词后缀，指“所知道的东西”，即“知识；学问”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 值得自豪的人（或事物）；骄傲
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The new sports stadium is the pride of the town.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：proud（自豪的）的名词形式是 pride，记住“骄傲”的发音口型较大（ai拉长）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I hope you'll join in the Christmas celebrations.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：celebrate（庆祝）+ ion（名词后缀） -> 庆祝活动；庆典。常用短语 join in the celebration（参加庆祝活动）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It's becoming fashionable to have long hair again.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：fashion（时尚）+ able（能……的） -> 时尚的，即“流行的；时兴的”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Many shops have raised their prices.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：与 rose（玫瑰）同源相关，用手把东西举起来/抬高即“提高；增加”。注意区别不及物的 rise。

unit_vocabulary.comparison: make a difference vs make a decision
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Changing schools made a big difference to my life.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：make（做）+ a difference（一个不同） -> 制造出一份不同，即“有影响；有作用”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Austin was encouraged to begin playing the guitar by his father.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：en（使……）+ courage（勇气） -> 使有勇气，即“鼓励；支持”。常用搭配 encourage sb. to do sth.（鼓励某人做某事）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He was waving his arms to draw their attention.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：draw（拉/吸引）+ attention（注意力） -> 把注意力吸引过来，即“引起某人的注意”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A bus appeared around the corner.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：ap（朝）+ pear（梨） -> 梨从角落冒出来，即“出现”。其反义词是 disappear（消失）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He provided us with a lot of useful information.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：provide（提供）+ sb. with sth. -> 为某人提供某物，即“为……提供……”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The squirrels are storing up nuts for the winter.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：store（储存）+ up（起来/收起） -> 收起来储存，即“储存”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The tour included a visit to the Science Museum.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：in（在内）+ clude（关闭/包含） -> 关在里面，即“包括；包含”。
联想记忆：perform（表演）+ ance（名词后缀） -> 表演；演出。

unit_vocabulary.comparison: prepare for... vs prepare to do
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We all set about preparing for the party.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：prepare（准备）+ for（为了） -> 为了某事做准备，即“为……作准备”。
